key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:20BC
name: write_bytes_to_stream_node
description: Copies bytes from a source pointer into the node's current output buffer one at a time, up to the node's remaining count, and calls a helper after each newline when a newline flag is set. It sets status bits on the error paths and returns a status code.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:21E8
name: read_bytes_from_stream_node
description: Copies bytes from the node's current buffer position into a caller buffer, fetching a fresh chunk through a helper whenever the node's remaining count runs out. It updates the node's counters and status bits and returns a status code.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:2360
name: update_file_node_state
description: With no node argument, walks the linked list of nodes from a fixed head and records an error when a helper called on an active node reports failure. With a node argument it resets the node's position and counters, clears status bits, and compares a helper result against the stored count to set error bits.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:2430
name: close_stream_node
description: Returns minus one if the node is missing or has no state set. Otherwise it flushes pending output through a helper when a flag is set, clears the node's state word, calls another helper, and returns zero on success or minus one on failure.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:2434
name: close_stream_node_via_register
description: Performs the same close sequence as the stack-argument variant: it checks the node for presence and state, flushes pending output through a helper when flagged, clears the state word, calls a second helper, and returns zero or minus one.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:249E
name: parse_open_mode_string
description: Reads a two-character mode string whose first character is a, r or w, with optional plus and b markers, and turns it into access flags. It calls a helper with those flags and, on success, stores the returned value and flags in the node; it returns the node or zero.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:25D4
name: find_or_allocate_free_node
description: Searches the linked list of nodes from a fixed head for one whose active field is zero, allocating a new node through a helper when none is free. The new node is zero-filled over its first 33 bytes, linked onto the list, and passed to a helper for setup.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:264C
name: format_one_printf_conversion
description: Parses one printf-style conversion specifier, reading its flags, width, precision and length modifier, then fetches the argument and formats it as a number, string or character with padding. It returns the pointer past the specifier, and the count-storing specifier writes the running output count through a pointer argument.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:2A84
name: emit_format_string_text
description: Walks a format string, passing ordinary characters and escaped percent signs to an output routine, and handing each percent-prefixed conversion to the specifier parser. It stops at the terminating zero byte.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:2AF0
name: delete_file_record_error
description: Calls the DOS library's file-delete routine; when the call fails it stores the DOS error code and the result of a second library call. It returns true when the delete failed and false when it succeeded.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:2B20
name: stub_return_immediately
description: The routine contains no operations and returns at once, so it is an empty stub with no effect on data, hardware or the caller.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:2B7C
name: forward_call_to_helper
description: Calls one other routine and then returns, passing no data through and changing nothing itself.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD].adf:Wing:0:0000
name: release_memory_and_patch_word
description: Program entry code that calls a few helpers, then runs three memory-free library calls in a loop. It clears a local value, follows a chain of pointers to test a stored word against a fixed constant, and when they match, saves that word and replaces it with a global value.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD].adf:Wing:0:0064
name: decrement_until_minus_one
description: Decrements a 16-bit counter in a loop until it passes zero and reaches minus one, then returns. It touches no memory and only spends time.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD].adf:bootblock:0:01CC
name: walk_length_prefixed_entries
description: Walks a table of variable-length entries, advancing by the size stored at each entry's third byte plus three, and calls two library routines per entry. It stops at a zero byte in the table.
